name: Mérk (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of yellow and green triangles and yellow squares in the fly corners, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mérk: a blue shield with a white cup and a red charge, with a helm, a crest and red, green and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed MÉRK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
